## Overview

In this session you can learn more about R’s data visualization package ggplot. The workshop will answer the following questions:

- Why ggplot (difference between base plot and ggplot2)?
- How do you make plots using ggplot2 in R?
- How do you customize and modify plots?

## What you'll learn

- Learn Grammar of the graphics & synatx
- Build a graph (data visualization) from the scratch
- Describe Geometric components of a graph
- Produce different kinds of plot (scatter plots, boxplots, barplots etc) using ggplot.
- Describe what faceting is and apply faceting in ggplot.
- Modify the aesthetics of an existing ggplot plot (including theme, axis labels, stats and color etc).
- Combine and save plots as publishable figures.

## Prerequisites

 Please have R and RStudio installed on your computer. Install ggplot2 by typing `install.packages("ggplot2")` into the console of your RStudio.

This session uses the publicly available [Penguins data set](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/). You can install the data with: `install.packages("palmerpenguins")`.
